profile.summary: The SIFE Equity Project is a nonprofit that works with teachers and schools to support immigrant students in middle and high school who have had limited or interrupted formal education (called SIFE or SLIFE students). It develops curriculum, offers workshops and coaches teachers.

sources.title: The Sife Equity Project Inc - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica
